# `tfctl profile profiles activate`

The `tfctl profile profiles activate` command activates an existing profile.

## Usage

```shell-session
$ tfctl profile profiles activate NAME [options]
```

## Description

The `tfctl profile profiles activate` command activates an existing profile. Once activated, the profile becomes the default profile used by all tfctl commands unless overridden with the `--profile` global flag.

## Arguments

- `NAME`: (Required) The name of the profile to activate.

## Available options

The `tfctl profile profiles activate` command does not accept any command-specific options.

### Global flags

Refer to [Global flags reference](/terraform/tfctl-cli/reference/cli#global-flags) for information about flags you can use with all commands.

## Examples

The following examples demonstrate how to activate an existing profile.

### Activate a profile by name

The following example activates a profile by name. Replace `<PROFILE_NAME>` with the name of the profile to activate.

```shell-session
$ tfctl profile profiles activate `<PROFILE_NAME>`
```

### Activate the default profile

The following example activates the default profile.

```shell-session
$ tfctl profile profiles activate default
```
